name: BrokerStatusWindow
notes: Figma is not linked yet. The header carries the connection name, the status dot, the staleness pill, the time-range selector and the metrics gear, and nothing else: the broker facts live in the health strip below. The shell wraps the body in an overflow-y-auto scroll container so that strip can pin. On macOS the header keeps its total height but shifts its content up (pt-2 pb-4) so the row centres on the traffic lights. The selected range is persisted per connection under a namespaced key in the chart-window table. Dividing lines use the outline token, matching how the main window's sidebar and data view divide themselves.
